references.title: CMG2/ANTXR2 regulates extracellular collagen VI which accumulates in hyaline fibromatosis syndrome.

assessment.review_notes: Actual collagen VI binding and uptake/degradation Methods/Results read. Binding reagent is pepsinized human-tissue collagen VI; the gifted uptake tetramers have unspecified species. Human RPE1/patient-fibroblast lysosomal cargo evidence is retained without relabeling every preparation as mouse or human.

references.title: Physical exercise stimulates autophagy in normal skeletal muscles but is detrimental for collagen VI-deficient muscles.

assessment.review_notes: Actual mouse knockout muscle ultrastructure and physiological Methods/Results read in the localization consultation. SR dilation is pathology; a target-protein SR localization experiment is not established by that result.

references.title: Oxidative stress by monoamine oxidases is causally involved in myofiber damage in muscular dystrophy.

assessment.review_notes: Recovered original author-uploaded indexed Methods/Results read in the localization consultation. Mouse tropomyosin oxidation, MAO and contractile phenotypes do not establish COL6A1 localization within myofibrils. Original normal abstract and failed publisher access are preserved.

references.title: Developmental regulation of biglycan expression in muscle and tendon.

assessment.review_notes: Complete authentic abstract concerns biglycan/muscle development, including collagen VI context. Exact mouse same-term sarcolemma record is verified, but full original localization image/Methods were not recovered. GO sarcolemma includes extracellular covering matrix.

references.title: Annexin A2 mediates secretion of collagen VI, pulmonary elasticity and apoptosis of bronchial epithelial cells.

assessment.review_notes: Authentic full PMC HTML was recovered in the localization consultation. Actual mouse bronchial epithelial immunogold, microsome, VAMP2 and mouse Col6a1-GFP secretion assays were read, distinguishing WT vesicle presence from KO accumulation. No selected-cache rewrite.

references.title: Autophagy is defective in collagen VI muscular dystrophies, and its reactivation rescues myofiber degeneration.

assessment.review_notes: Complete original abstract reports mouse collagen VI deficiency, altered autophagy/myofiber integrity and rescue, with human biopsy context. Full original Methods were not recovered; no direct COL6A1 autophagy-enzyme activity is inferred.

references.title: Multiple Mechanisms Converging on Transcription Factor EB Activation by the Natural Phenol Pterostilbene.

assessment.review_notes: Actual zebrafish col6a1 morpholino and rescue Methods/Results, muscle birefringence/motility and TFEB-context passages were read. This is a direct vertebrate muscle perturbation study, not a human COL6A1 catalytic assay.

final_science_delta.after: Refine the positive association to its verified collagen counterpart class. Two exact current records map canonical human COL6A1 and COL9A1 to anti-tag affinity purification/co-immunoprecipitation in 293T and HCT116 cells; official P20849 is collagen alpha1(IX). GO:0005518 narrows the accepted binding partner to collagen without asserting an additional enzyme or adaptor mechanism. final_science_delta.before: Retain the broad electronic cell-differentiation association as a contextual extracellular-matrix contribution. Collagen VI-containing matrices and tissue phenotypes provide biological context, but the particular osteoblast and endoderm expression studies do not by themselves resolve a causal COL6A1-performed differentiation step and remain undecided separately. No cell-fate transcription factor or autonomous differentiation mechanism is assigned.
final_science_delta.after: The current definition requires acquisition of specialized cellular features by a relatively unspecialized cell. Actual collagen VI lung experiments demonstrate spreading, density and barrier maturation in airway epithelial cultures, while the authors leave the developmental ontogeny of the knockout phenotype unresolved. The osteoblast/endoderm papers provide positive expression observations without a COL6A1 intervention. These findings preserve meaningful matrix biology but do not settle the electronic cell-differentiation attribution or its historical ARBA premise. Leave the specific assertion unresolved without requiring intrinsic fate-control activity or denying structural participation.

definition.text: The cellular developmental process in which a relatively unspecialized cell, e.g. embryonic or regenerative cell, acquires specialized structural and/or functional features that characterize a specific cell. Differentiation includes the processes involved in commitment of a cell to a specific fate and its subsequent development to the mature state.

Binding to collagen, a group of fibrous proteins of very high tensile strength that form the main component of connective tissue in animals. Collagen is highly enriched in glycine (some regions are 33% glycine) and proline, occurring predominantly as 3-hydroxyproline (about 20%).

definition.text: A constituent of the extracellular matrix that enables the matrix to resist longitudinal stress.

definition.text: The contractile element of skeletal and cardiac muscle; a long, highly organized bundle of actin, myosin, and other proteins that contracts by a sliding filament mechanism.

official_terms.name: sarcoplasmic reticulum

definition.text: A fine reticular network of membrane-limited elements that pervades the sarcoplasm of a muscle cell; continuous over large portions of the cell and with the nuclear envelope; that part of the endoplasmic reticulum specialized for calcium release, uptake and storage.

official_terms.comment: See also the cellular component terms 'sarcoplasm ; GO:0016528', 'nuclear envelope ; GO:0005635' and 'endoplasmic reticulum ; GO:0005783'.

definition.text: The process in which a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of an endoderm cell, a cell of the inner of the three germ layers of the embryo.
The process whereby a relatively unspecialized cell acquires the specialized features of an osteoblast, a mesodermal or neural crest cell that gives rise to bone.

Extracellular matrix components occurring independently or along with elastin. Thought to have force-bearing functions in tendon. In addition to fibrillins, microfibrils may contain microfibrillar-Associated Proteins (MFAPs): MFAP1, MFAP2 (also known as MAGP-1), MFAP3, MFAP4, and MFAP5 (also known as MAGP-2).
A family of collagens containing multiple von Willebrand factor A (vWA) domains.
